colemarkpearson: Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear found a place in R-F15 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Benedikt Durham and Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At relief, the next watch was told it had been a good hour.
martinsatalik: At the depot, Severin Martinsatali had practised answering to his name. At S-F7, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
noel_cocac: Jakub "Ash" Cocac reached S-F17 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
vuminhtri260709: Nobody asked Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri why he came. Nobody in S-F11 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F11 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
Gideon Allistofeari of the Hegemony and Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri of the Concord watched a broken branch near the Brickworks all morning. Neither side could afford to assume it was only a branch.
